'''Brandon Miller''' designed the 20 September 2008 redesign of [[swccgpc.com]], the official website of the [[Players Committee]]. He posted the launch announcement, "New site is LIVE!", under the handle '''brandon.miller'''. The same news page credits him in its footer as "Brandon Miller Website design + development 2008".<ref name="pc-news0809">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080925013637/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/ News (September 2008)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 25 September 2008. The "New site is LIVE!" item is posted by brandon.miller; the footer reads "Brandon Miller Website design + development 2008".</ref>
